title: Email Address Validator
description: Validate one or many email addresses. Returns syntax check, MX record lookup, SMTP RCPT TO result, disposable/role/free flags, typo suggestion, optional catch-all detection, and a 0–100 deliverability score per address.

emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: List of email addresses to validate. Pass a single address as a one-item array. Each entry is normalized to lowercase before validation. Example: ["jane@example.com", "info@acme.io"]. NOT a CSV file path or a domain — supply individual full addresses.

maxEmails.title: Maximum emails to validate
maxEmails.description: Hard cap for unique emails processed and charged in this run. Use 1000 for the largest supported batch or a smaller number to control event cost. Defaults to 1000. NOT a pagination offset; duplicate addresses are removed before this cap is applied.

verificationTier.title: Verification tier
verificationTier.description: Choose standard for the built-in preflight signals or premium for a deeper, owner-managed verification result. Premium runs are capped at 100 unique emails to keep the maximum charge predictable.

checkSmtp.title: Run live SMTP probe (experimental)
checkSmtp.description: When true, attempts a live SMTP RCPT TO probe to confirm the mailbox accepts mail. NOTE: most cloud platforms (Apify included, since it runs on AWS) block outbound port 25, so SMTP probes from Apify usually return 'unknown'. The actor still works perfectly without SMTP — syntax + MX + disposable/role/free/typo checks already catch 60–80% of bad addresses. Leave OFF unless you self-host. Default: false.

checkCatchAll.title: Detect catch-all domains
checkCatchAll.description: When true and checkSmtp=true, probes a random non-existent address on the same domain to detect catch-all servers. Same cloud-port-25 caveat applies as checkSmtp. Default: false.

concurrency.title: Concurrent validations
concurrency.description: How many emails to validate in parallel. Higher = faster but may hit per-host rate limits and cause 'unknown' SMTP results. Recommended 5–15 for most lists. Maximum 50. Default: 10.

timeoutMs.title: SMTP timeout (milliseconds)
timeoutMs.description: Per-connection timeout for the SMTP probe. Strict mailservers can take 5–10s. Lower values increase 'unknown' verdicts; higher values increase run time. Default: 8000 (8 seconds). Range: 1000–30000.
